method: Read-only bounded source review plus separate genuine-body event-boundary CPU control; component and root SDK checks retain their own scopes.
remaining_limitations: The earlier PM callback event and cancellation CAS are distinct; a delayed hook may leave a commit-acceptance window, including after the original fixed budget has elapsed.
A source callsite must report the actual endpoint return; the commit API does not independently observe physical hardware completion.
This is not a proof of all original/firmware MMIO producers, BME irreversibility, posted-write drain or whole hardware DMA stop.
The retained cleanup observer covers sticky RETAINED only; a clean record already in CLOSING is outside this narrow identity path.
The actual full-mask operation with original GPU/lock/runtime state was not executed by this review; its transitive cleanup remains separate evidence.
Aggregate context-sensitive stack, OOM/generic/external/recursive callbacks, target capacity and framework/reentry headroom remain unproved.
Arbitrary callback duration, scheduling and physical endpoint latency are not a 30-second PM completion bound.
No complete operational runtime, kernel execution, native final link or target package was established.
reviewed_invariants: Allocator algorithms move byte-identically into file-local always-inline bodies; generic exported ABI and actual OOM/dynamic callback obligations remain.
Commit acceptance uses the same genuine cancellation control word as revocation reservation, exact bound state and actual current enrolled origin.
A monotonic opaque serial plus binding, current thread and origin protect completion; Finish, Unbind and cleanup transition refuse an outstanding reservation.
Revocation never clears an accepted endpoint reservation; valid leave after the endpoint returns does not authorize new operation work.
Timer/TX/Session endpoint errors retain their real earlier failure; completion error cannot fabricate rollback.
IRQ leave failure after physical enable closes callback acceptance while preserving actual attempted/enabled/mask-required state.
New typed GPU bridges check null before obtaining the actual original-state pointer.
The aligned known original BAR0 writers and bound Session BME-enabling writes use the same operation commit gate; unaligned original writes refuse.

The separate sticky cleanup observer preserves first error/phase and requires the genuine retained master, original returns, global READY validation, revoked CLEANUP deadline and absence of tracked producer obligations.
Strict liveEntries==0 is retained: actual successful return/cancel protocols clear tags; no synthetic COMPLETE exemption is accepted.
Only the full-mask path uses retained cleanup identity; the ordinary 1Hz callback drain keeps its original operation authorizer.
Nested source replay preserves the historical operational record, exact source identities, private namespace and all three complete entry-gate files.
